text: The presentation provides information on the status of the inclusion of gender affirming benefits not covered by OHIP into the City employee benefit plans.

The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Manager, Gender Equity, Social Development to request the Director, Total Rewards, People and Equity provide an update to the Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee before the end of the term on the progress, evaluation, and potential expansion of transgender heath benefits to all City employees.
